label: Actual station operation with positive-duration causal linkage
definition: StationOperationAt R h stations u c n asserts that station bearers n and n+1 exist and are present at the assigned c n and c(n+1) moments of one history u, that the earlier station n+1 actually causes (in the supplied Ontic.Causes sense) the later station n, and that the existing four-rule PieceAt R u c n protocol is realized. The efficient causal influence is an additional world-relative fact, not a proof that the receiver exists because of the transmitter, not a memberwise totality cause and not merely an intrinsic capability. The ontology of signal events and the cause-of-operation interpretation still require a bridge.
note: Analyst stronger actual-operation semantics for #1489, distinct from Koons's CPNPP, which directly preserves powers to influence events but does not by itself establish actual influence at every link. All host, admissibility and reliable-protocol conditions are additional open application responsibilities.
